app_process_guard_lesson.observation: CUA menu quit removed the NeTelegram app from its inventory, but the sandboxed local process guard could not prove absence and correctly refused replacement.
app_process_guard_lesson.resolution: Used a narrowly scoped elevated pgrep for only NeTelegram; exit 1 confirmed absence. Then the existing canonical Scripts/dev-app.sh --launch workflow built exactly once and launched the pinned current-source bundle. No guard was bypassed.
app_process_guard_lesson.future_rule: If process enumeration is restricted, first quit through the app UI; then use a narrow authorized process check. Never infer absence from LaunchServices alone, never force-kill, and never create a second Dev.app.
